item.description:
• A card can now be backed up to several drives at once (up to seven), and you pick them as the last step
  • The transfer screen shows a tab for each drive, with the card and the backups side by side
  • A stopped backup can be continued, from the transfer screen or from its card
  • A file that fails mid-copy is reported straight away, and Retry works while the copy is still running
  • Copies are never written to a drive that isn't plugged in
  • Safety checks stop you from picking someone else's project folder or a card folder that's already there
  • The new-project wizard suggests the day, card number and drives based on what you did before
  • Each drive gets its own log
  • Clearer Copy Options, with Flat and Rename files as the defaults
  • Fixed: a new project's name could wrongly come back as "already exists"
• Test update — nothing changes in the app. If you're reading this, updates work.
• First build that updates itself: the app now checks for new versions once a day, and MediaManager > Check for Updates… checks right away.
